results.description:
For fans of Elin Hilderbrand, Kristin Hannah, and Kristy Woodson Harvey.

From the wreckage of a national scandal to the heartbreak of a widow's hidden secrets, two best friends discover that some confessions lead to love and others cost too much.

Meaghan Jones is America's sweetheart until a Hollywood scandal sends her seeking refuge at her best friend's beach house on the Delaware shore. She's sworn off romance, but the magnetic restaurateur she's never forgotten keeps testing her resolve, stirring feelings she thought she'd buried forever.

Palmer Harding has the perfect life until her husband drops dead. No one knows they hadn't spoken in weeks. No one knows she kissed another man just days before. And no one can know the secret she's carrying now.

As summer unfolds under salt air and starlit skies, friendship, love, and long-buried truths collide. For one unforgettable season, two women discover that second chances—in love and in life—are worth every risk.

Includes four original recipes from the characters themselves.

✔ Second-chance romance with emotional depth
✔ Women's fiction set on the Delaware coast
✔ Female friendship, family secrets, and fresh starts
✔ Perfect for fans of Elin Hilderbrand, Kristin Hannah, Kristy Woodson Harvey, and Susan Mallery

4.4 stars across 440+ reviews!

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ This book has it all! Read this for my book club and it was the perfect summer beach read. This book has it all-friendship, drama, romance, scandal! Had the opportunity to meet the author at our meeting and she was incredibly kind and down to earth. Can’t wait to see what she comes up with next. Certainly an author to watch!!! - Reader on Amazon

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ I Was Hooked...Addictive Beach Read with Juicy Secrets. This story manages to provide glorious escapism while still being very realistic. The family angst, a new romance, and a couple of "OMG" twists kept me turning pages! - Paperback Princess on Amazon

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ Excellent. An emotional mine field. I cried, I laughed, and then I wondered about the way each character would deal with their emotions. Love in families, love in marriage, love across time. Wonderful! - William on GoodReads

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ This book was a surprise. As I sat down to read it, I started out thinking this is why I read, to relax and it was so nice. I kept reading, and the pace picked up, and I thought this is my life, start out slow, then picks up. Well it continued, it got my heart pumping, with all that is going on. This continued as I read this story, right to the end. … Kara Gorski's writing is so unique. - Nana on BookBub
